Alexander Bernhardsson.note: Bernhardsson gives Sweden a front-line rhythm that keeps defenders facing their own goal. His value often starts before the ball reaches him.
Alexander Bernhardsson.noteZh: 他给Sweden替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Alexander Isak.note: Isak has already given Sweden a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Alexander Isak.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Anthony Elanga.note: Elanga gives Sweden a scorer opponents now have to carry in their heads. His goals against Netherlands and Japan make every loose ball feel heavier.
Anthony Elanga.noteZh: 他已经是Sweden这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Benjamin Nygren.note: Nygren gives Sweden midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Benjamin Nygren.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Sweden来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Besfort Zeneli.note: Zeneli is midfield insurance for Sweden. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Besfort Zeneli.noteZh: 他给Sweden一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Carl Starfelt.note: Starfelt is back-line insurance for Sweden. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Carl Starfelt.noteZh: 他给Sweden那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Daniel Svensson.note: Svensson is defensive cover for Sweden's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Daniel Svensson.noteZh: 他是Sweden在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Elliot Stroud.note: Stroud gives Sweden another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Elliot Stroud.noteZh: 他是Sweden在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Eric Smith.summary: Eric Smith is a Sweden centre-back at St. Pauli who gives the national team defensive midfield cover, back-line calm, and long passing.
Eric Smith.note: Smith is defensive cover for Sweden's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Eric Smith.noteZh: 他是Sweden在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Gabriel Gudmundsson.note: Gudmundsson has been part of Sweden's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Gabriel Gudmundsson.noteZh: 他在Sweden体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Gustaf Lagerbielke.summary: Gustaf Lagerbielke is a Sweden centre-back at Braga who gives the national team aerial defending, duel strength, and back-line depth.
Gustaf Lagerbielke.note: Lagerbielke has been part of Sweden's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Gustaf Lagerbielke.noteZh: 他在Sweden体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Gustaf Nilsson.summary: Gustaf Nilsson is a Sweden centre-forward at Club Brugge who gives the national team hold-up play, aerial presence, and penalty-box depth.
Gustaf Nilsson.note: Nilsson gives Sweden a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Gustaf Nilsson.noteZh: 他是Sweden在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Herman Johansson.note: Johansson gives Sweden cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Herman Johansson.noteZh: 他是Sweden后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Hjalmar Ekdal.note: Ekdal gives Sweden cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Hjalmar Ekdal.noteZh: 他是Sweden后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Isak Hien.note: Hien is in the quiet-work part of Sweden's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Isak Hien.noteZh: 他是Sweden主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.note: Zetterström is goalkeeper cover for Sweden. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.noteZh: 他是Sweden门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Lucas Bergvall.note: Bergvall has already made a goal happen for Sweden. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Lucas Bergvall.noteZh: 他已经为Sweden送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Mattias Svanberg.note: Svanberg has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Tunisia. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Mattias Svanberg.noteZh: 他已经为Sweden进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Taha Ali.note: Ali gives Sweden a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Taha Ali.noteZh: 他是Sweden在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Victor Lindelof.note: Lindelöf is in the quiet-work part of Sweden's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Victor Lindelof.noteZh: 他是Sweden主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Viktor Gyokeres.note: Gyökeres has already given Sweden a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Viktor Gyokeres.noteZh: 他给Sweden展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Viktor Johansson.note: Johansson gives Sweden a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Viktor Johansson.noteZh: 他在Sweden首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Yasin Ayari.note: Ayari has been one of Sweden's real scoring stories, with goals against Tunisia. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Yasin Ayari.noteZh: 他已经是Sweden这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。
